The '''''Vigilance''''' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]]. It served as a [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during the final year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The ''Vigilance'' was a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]<ref name="EPIII" /> and a part of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]]<ref name="SWCE" /> during the final year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="EPIIIN" /> The ''Vigilance'' had 8 [[DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turret/Legends|DBY-827 heavy turbolaser turrets]], a pair of command towers<ref name="EPIII" /> and an equipped hyperdrive.<ref name="EPIIIN" />

==History==
[[File:Battleofutapau.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Vigilance'' arrives at Utapau.]]
The ''Vigilance'' served as [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] during the final days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When given the task of pursuing the CIS ringleader [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on Utapau, Kenobi transferred to the ''Vigilance'' over Coruscant, where he was briefed on the situation by his [[Cody/Legends|clone commander]] and dispatched to Utapau in his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's blue Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|interceptor]].<ref name="EPIII" />

The ''Vigilance'' later arrived at Utapau to provide back-up for Kenobi as he battled Grievous amid the sinkhole cities of Utapau.<ref name="EPIII" /> When [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was initiated, the ''Vigilance'' was instructed to scramble [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] to pursue and [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kenobi. However, Kenobi, who had escaped in [[Soulless One/Legends|Grievous's fighter]], was too fast, and the fighters were not able to catch up to him.<ref name="EPIIIN" />
